youtube.title: New in funkbox: a pill behind each caption word, and the text audit still checks every one
youtube.description:
A pill behind each word as it types: this week's new caption highlight, used on every caption here.
The pill only decorates the approved copy; the text audit checked all 9 on-screen strings, exact. Rendered in 40 s on a 4-core CPU, no GPU.
Free, open source, runs locally: https://github.com/IsraelWebDev/funkbox
Made with funkbox.

x.text:
Word-by-word captions, with a pill behind each word as it types. That's this week's addition to IsraelWebDev/funkbox.

The pill sits behind approved copy and never changes it: all 9 strings in this Short matched it byte for byte.

#captions #shorts
